topic: track spending with a budgeting app
core_question: How do I track my spending using a budgeting app? (secondary: How do I get my smart TV connected to my home wifi?)
answer_summary: Sign up for a budgeting app, securely link your bank and credit card accounts, let it auto-categorize transactions, and review the resulting spending totals by category each week or month.; after the topic shift: Open the TV's Settings > Network menu, select the home wifi network from the list, and enter the wifi password using the on-screen keyboard/remote.
persona: friendly but persistent; chatty and verbose
